mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix fact allows the model to assign arbitrary (role, operation) pairs to PermMatrix.Allowed, violating the least-privilege constraint that only documented roles can access documented operations.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { HospitalAdministrator -> ReadRecord in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the structural uniqueness constraint on note_id allows two distinct clinical notes to have the same ID, violating the immutability and append-only invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateNoteIds { some disj n1, n2: ClinicalNote | n1.note_id = n2.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the one-audit-per-note constraint allows orphaned notes (notes with no matching audit entry), violating the completeness requirement that every note addition must be logged.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanedNote { some n: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.access_type = AddNote and ae.note_id = n.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing care-team gating allows a clinical note to be authored by a user not on the patient's care team, violating the ownership-based access control requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonCareTeamAuthor { some n: ClinicalNote | no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician.user_id = n.author_user_id and ctm.patient = n.patient and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the byte-equivalence constraint allows a Denied outcome to occur when a valid care-team membership exists, which would leak information about membership status to an unauthorized caller.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InfoLeakage { some ae: AuditEntry, ctm: CareTeamMembership | (ae.outcome = Denied or ae.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied) and ctm.clinician.user_id = ae.user_id and ctm.patient.patient_id = ae.patient_id and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the audit-attribution constraint allows an audit entry to record a user_role that differs from the actual user's role, violating the requirement that audit snapshots accurately represent the accessor's role at access time.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedRole { some ae: AuditEntry, u: User | ae.user_id = u.user_id and ae.user_role != u.user_role }
